description: Cyclone Tracy collection is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by People, Sport and Culture. The Cyclone Tracy collection pays tribute to the victims and survivors of this tragedy by preserving documents, photographs, recordings and personal stories about the cyclone and its aftermath. The dataset includes metadata describing the items, including permalinks to the items in Territory Stories nt. gov. au. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher People, Sport and Culture. Its tags are Cyclone Tracy, History, Territory Stories. It offers 3 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2024-10-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
